d: CM Samrat Meets Prashant Kishor: bihar ki siyasat men CM samrat chaudhri aur prashant kishor ki tasvir vayral hai.... tasvir men mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri aur jan suraj ke sansthapak prashant kishor sath baithe hain... chehre par muskan hai... hathon men chay ka pyala hai... aur donon ke bich lanbi batchit ho rahi hai... khas bat ye hai ki ek-dusre par siyasi hamle karne vale in do netaon ki is mulakat men aarjedi neta rohini aachary bhi shamil hueen... ab saval hai ki chay ki is chuski ke pichhe koee siyasi sandesh hai ya phir ye mahaj ek shishtachar mulakat thi? kyonki 30 navanbar se…
